name: pg_achievements
abstract: Game achievements for PostgreSQL users, unlocked by what they do in the database
description: pg_achievements watches what roles do in PostgreSQL and awards bronze, silver and gold achievements, with an instant notice in the client, a NOTIFY for chat bots and a rarity score; a single platinum one crowns the full collection. 68 builtin achievements nudge users toward EXPLAIN ANALYZE, recursive CTEs, window functions, MERGE and partitioning, and poke fun at UPDATE without WHERE, cartesian products or Friday evening deploys. Requires shared_preload_libraries.
